key.name: dock-position
key.summary: Screen edge position of the Reef dock
key.description: Screen edge where the dock is anchored ('BOTTOM').

key.name: dock-fixed
key.summary: Keep dock fixed and always visible
key.description: When true, the dock stays permanently visible and reserves a Mutter workspace strut. When false, intelligent auto-hide is used.

key.name: intellihide
key.summary: Enable intelligent window-dodge auto-hide
key.description: When true and dock-fixed is false, the dock stays visible on an empty desktop and hides only when windows overlap its target box.

key.name: intellihide-mode
key.summary: Intellihide window overlap mode
key.description: Which windows trigger intellihide: 'ALL_WINDOWS' (Kelp friendly), 'FOCUSED_WINDOW', or 'MAXIMIZED_ONLY'.

key.name: require-pressure-to-show
key.summary: Require pointer edge pressure to reveal hidden dock
key.description: When true, uses a Wayland Meta.Barrier pressure threshold along the screen edge to reveal the hidden dock.

key.name: pressure-threshold
key.summary: Edge pressure threshold in pixels
key.description: Pointer pressure distance (20–500 px) required to trigger dock reveal.

key.name: autohide-in-fullscreen
key.summary: Allow edge reveal in fullscreen applications
key.description: When true, pushing against the screen edge can reveal the dock even while a fullscreen window is active.

key.name: extend-height
key.summary: Extend dock across full screen edge (panel mode)
key.description: When false, renders a centered floating pill with a 6px edge margin. When true, stretches the dock across the full monitor edge.

key.name: multi-monitor
key.summary: Show Reef dock on all connected monitors
key.description: When true, creates a Reef dock instance on every monitor instead of only the primary monitor.

key.name: dash-max-icon-size
key.summary: Maximum application icon size in pixels
key.description: Maximum size of application icons in the dock (24–64 px).

key.name: show-apps-at-top
key.summary: Place Show Apps button at the start of the dock
key.description: When true, places the Show Apps launcher button at the left side of the dock instead of the right side.

key.name: show-show-apps-button
key.summary: Show the Show Apps launcher button
key.description: Whether the Show Apps grid button is visible in the dock.

key.name: show-favorites
key.summary: Show pinned favorite applications
key.description: Whether pinned favorite applications are displayed in the dock.

key.name: show-running
key.summary: Show running unpinned applications
key.description: Whether running applications that are not pinned are displayed in the dock.

key.name: isolate-workspaces
key.summary: Isolate running applications to active workspace
key.description: When true, running indicators and window cycling only include windows on the currently active workspace.

key.name: click-action
key.summary: Left-click action on running application icon
key.description: Behavior when left-clicking a running app: 'focus-or-cycle', 'focus-or-minimize', or 'launch'.

key.name: middle-click-action
key.summary: Middle-click action on application icon
key.description: Behavior when middle-clicking an app icon: 'launch', 'minimize', or 'quit'.

key.name: scroll-action
key.summary: Mouse wheel scroll action over dock icons
key.description: Behavior when scrolling over an app icon: 'cycle-windows', 'switch-workspace', or 'none'.

key.name: background-opacity
key.summary: Dock pill background opacity percentage
key.description: Opacity of the dock background from 0 (transparent) to 100 (solid).

key.name: show-icon-background
key.summary: Show background tiles behind application icons
key.description: When true, draws a subtle rounded tile behind each application icon at rest. When false, keeps app icon backgrounds transparent until hovered while preserving the Show Apps launcher tile.

key.name: show-border
key.summary: Show accent border around the dock pill
key.description: When true, draws a high-contrast border ring around the Reef dock matching Kelp.

key.name: border-width
key.summary: Dock border width in pixels
key.description: Thickness of the dock border in CSS pixels (0–8 px, default 2 px matching Kelp).

key.name: border-radius
key.summary: Dock corner radius in pixels
key.description: Corner rounding of the floating dock pill in CSS pixels (0–32 px).

key.name: border-color-rgba
key.summary: Dock accent border color
key.description: CSS RGB/RGBA string for the dock border ring (default Coral Red matching Kelp).

key.name: dock-margin
key.summary: Floating dock screen-edge margin in pixels
key.description: Gap between the floating dock pill and the bottom screen edge in CSS pixels (0–24 px, default 6 px).
